events.title: Demo update: co-op, staff and new rooms
events.summary: A big update for the demo. Here's what's new.Co-op for up to 4 playersInvite your friends through Steam and run the same warehouse together. One sorts, one serves, one knocks everything over. The difficulty scales with your group. Hire some helpA porter who runs goods to the counter, a mule who carries what you can't, and a cat who gathers matching items into one pile and falls asleep on it. events.summary: NewNew Garden: The shop now sits in a fully redesigned garden with updated walls, lawn, and doors. The weather is dynamic too: rain, hail and snow blow through it, and calm days get a gentle breeze.Expressive Characters: All characters feature hand-drawn faces that react to actions and events. events.title: Stash Mayhem Demo Available Now!
events.summary: The Demo is Live! The day has finally arrived: the Stash Mayhem Demo is officially available to play on Steam right now! Step into the shoes of a medieval warehouse manager, organize chaotic stashes, manage potions, scrolls, and magical loot, and see if you have what it takes to keep order amidst the chaos. events.title: Stash Mayhem Playtest is Live
events.summary: The playtest is live now and stays open for one week, closing August 1st. You should see it in your Steam library. If not, restart Steam, or hit "Request Access" on the store page. This is an early build, so expect rough edges. What we're testing Does the core loop feel good: sorting deliveries, serving customers, racing the clock? Is the pressure fun or just stressful?
